rev.t: IDo NOT fall for Zolo's "30% off your first month" bait. That's the hook, here's the trap: they hit you with a "token booking amount" just to hold the room before you even move in, then ANOTHER separate charge just for the privilege of …

They have increased the rent twice within just six months without any prior notification. Rent should not be increased twice in a year. Overall, this feels like a fraud
